articles.title: The True Purpose of Tarot
articles.highlight: 生活让我们惊讶，这一事实本身就证明它能让我们惊讶，而且会一次又一次地让我们惊讶。
articles.summary: 文章借一位朋友对侥幸之事的评论，反思人们常把对概率的判断误当成对可能性的完整认知。作者认为塔罗的真正意义不在预测未来，而在于让人重新接纳不确定性与意外。值得一读，因为它提供了看待命运与随机性的别样视角。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：不要把个人预测模型误认为现实的全部，意外的发生恰恰说明未来始终存在新的可能。保持对不确定性的开放，比盲目自信更有智慧。
articles.sourceExcerpt: “Nothing like this has ever happened before or will ever happen again,” a friend said to me about a lucky turn of events — a statement that struck me as touchingly self-negating: a recognition that life has violated her predictions about what is possible, immediately followed by a reassertion of unquestioned confidence in her powers of prediction. The very fact that life surprises us is evidence that it can surprise us, that it will surprise us over and over. To mistake our theories of probability for a realistic representation of possibility is to forget that the improbable gave us all… read article

articles.title: SenteLabsAI/OpenExecutive

articles.summary: OpenExecutive是一个已获3925颗星的开源项目，宣称用FastAPI与Next.js构建“AI虚拟高管团队”，将单一连贯的高管人格与多名专家代理结合。该项目值得关注的点在于它试图把多代理协作包装成可直接使用的组织级AI产品，而非单纯的技术演示。

It notes that OpenAI researchers are increasingly using coding agents, and the author speculates that the late-July surge in AI spend per researcher came from early internal access to the model later released as GPT-6 Astra. It is worth reading as a grounded glimpse into how a leading lab is adopting agentic engineering in practice.
en.failureAnalysis: This is an external blog-style interpretation rather than a systematic technical report, so statements about RSI, AGI, and spending spikes are partly speculative. Readers should distinguish established facts from the author's inferences.
en.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
